name: Arietta Fine
original_name: アリエッタ・フィーネ
source:
The elder twin sister of Tortinita. She stayed in her hometown while her sister and Chris went to attend the music school, because she lacked the ability and talent.

A quiet girl who's good at cooking and domestic work, she is Chris' girlfriend, and they communicate every week by sending letters to each other. Her nickname is Arie.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Symphonic_Rain]Wikipedia[/url]]
